definitions.explanation: A large body of water surrounded by land. Bigger than a pond ({池|いけ}).

examples.japanese: {湖|みずうみ}で{泳|およ}ぎました。
きれいな{湖|みずうみ}ですね。
examples.english: It's a beautiful lake, isn't it?

examples.japanese: {湖|みずうみ}のまわりを{歩|ある}きましょう。

notes: Composed of {水|みず} (water) and {海|うみ} (sea), literally 'water-sea'. Larger than {池|いけ} (pond). Famous lakes in Japan include {琵琶湖|びわこ} (Lake Biwa) and {河口湖|かわぐちこ} (Lake Kawaguchi).
